name: sse
description: Server-Sent Events with memory or Redis transport for multi-replica delivery.
instructions: Stream as a signed-in user:  curl -N -b cookies.txt 'localhost:5002/events/stream?topics=message'
Publish as an administrator (in another terminal):  curl -b admin-cookies.txt -XPOST localhost:5002/events -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"message":"hello"}'
Each data event is a default SSE message whose data is {"topic","data"}. A resync event means events were dropped, so reload state.
Publish from a module with EventsService.publish({ topic, audience, data }). An audience of userIds, roles, or organizationId limits who receives it.
Use publishAsync for confirmed delivery, publish for best-effort delivery, or publishLocal for events already fanned out to every replica.
Restrict who may subscribe to a topic with events.topics.register(topic, authorizer).
Register EVENT_IDENTITY in app.extensions.ts to give streams roles beyond admin and an active organization.
Select events=redis for multiple replicas or events=memory for a single process.
